global_upper_bound.method: For any fixed binding table and pre-intake history, let v be the maximum supplier license payoff at an unauthenticated record, and select a record r attaining v. For a record lottery with ADVANCED probability a and BASIC probability b, v=10a+2b, with a,b≥0 and a+b≤1. Certificate-unavailable types may both choose r; adversarial tie selection is included in the guarantee.
global_upper_bound.available_G_certifies_available_B_withho: Available G contributes at most 28 under BOOST or 24 under NORMAL. The other three type receipts summed before their probability weights are g(r)+2b_owner(r), equal to 4a+6b under BOOST and −16a+6b under NORMAL, hence at most 6. The resulting ceilings are 17/2 gross under BOOST and 15/2 under NORMAL.
global_upper_bound.available_G_certifies_available_B_certif: Available B certification requires certificate-record license payoff at least v+1. Under BOOST, the minimum owner loss at license payoff t is t for 0≤t≤2 and (5t−2)/4 for 2≤t≤10. Also g(r)+b_owner(r)≤4v for v≤2 and ≤v+6 for v≥2. Subtracting the minimum loss at t=v+1 bounds the three-type sum by 19/4, below 6. NORMAL has no larger G-plus-B sum and no smaller B loss, so its bound is also valid.
global_upper_bound.available_G_withholds_available_B_withho: Selecting r for every type yields gross receipt at most 8 under BOOST and at most 4 under NORMAL, both below their respective binding ceilings.
global_upper_bound.available_G_withholds_available_B_certif: The BOOST three-unauthenticated-type sum 2g(r)+b_owner(r) is at most 9v for v≤2 and (13v+46)/4 for v≥2. Subtracting the minimum certified-B loss at v+1, with v≤9, gives a four-type receipt sum at most 115/4, hence gross expected receipt at most 115/16. NORMAL’s corresponding sum is no larger and its B loss no smaller. This is below both relevant gross ceilings.
global_upper_bound.ties_histories_and_public_randomization: These cases include certification ties and arbitrary record lotteries. The current pair remains independent of displayed configurations and prior history, so conditioning on those variables preserves the four equally likely types. Averaging pointwise upper bounds cannot exceed them.
global_upper_bound.autonomous_and_final_ceiling: Each AUTONOMOUS equilibrium’s record action distributions can be installed as a BINDING table, with its supplier strategy still a best response; the same upper bounds therefore apply. Subtracting the BOOST charge gives 31/4, exceeding NORMAL’s 15/2. The complete binding policy attains 31/4 across every best response.
